summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused UI/API verification found leaderboard normalization mostly working, but the core checkout/ticket play flow is still broken: after a successful token checkout for a seeded live skill-game contest, the app navigated to /play/{ticket_id}?just_bought=1 and rendered a white blank page with no game and no Play later button. Existing My Tickets also links to /play/{ticket_id}, which is not a registered route and renders blank.

critical.issue: Required test contest is not in the promised launch state: API returns tickets_sold=5/tickets_total=5 (sold out), entry_mode derived as random_tickets, and game_type=null. Checkout against the exact requested contest fails with 400 'Only 0 tickets left', so it cannot exercise direct-to-game behavior without additional seeding.

minor.issue: Normalized score fields are present and top rows return 100.0 in API checks after score seeding. Contest rows also include duration_s and accuracy_pct. This part appears fixed at API level.

Ticket enrichment returns contest.title, but image is null for an existing ticket because the endpoint projects hero_image while contest documents use image. It also defaults missing entry_mode to skill_game even when the public contest is random_tickets/no game_type.

ui_bugs.issue: After a successful token checkout, final URL was /play/t_87168ca028c2?just_bought=1 and the page was white/blank. No data-testid=play-game-page, no game arena, and no data-testid=play-later-btn rendered.

Existing ticket card shows title and Play now, but no image (img_count=0). Clicking Play now navigates to /play/t_25dfb7a2415b and renders a blank page with no play-game-page, no game_arena, and no play-later button.

Global leaderboard is a horizontal list and shows normalized /100 plus a YOU badge for the signed-in user after score seeding. However the required contest c_8f482282e502 is not reachable as a contest tab because it has no game_type in preview data.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend redirects to /play/{ticket_id}, but App.js only registers /play/:contestId/:ticketId and PlayGame expects both contestId and ticketId. This route mismatch reproduces the user-reported white blank page after successful payment.

MyAccount links tickets to /play/{ticket_id}; the registered playable route needs contest_id too. The ticket endpoint also does not reliably provide image/game metadata to decide whether Play now should show.

issues: Successful purchase leaves the user on a visually blank white page with only a toast, not the game or tickets tab.
Play later CTA is absent because PlayGame never mounts on /play/{ticket_id}.
Ticket image is missing for the existing contest ticket, reducing contest visibility/trust.
24-hour attempt reminder notification was not meaningfully verified because the core post-checkout play route still fails. Retest this after checkout redirects to a working game/tickets page.

action_items: Fix the PlayGame route contract: either navigate to /play/{contest_id}/{ticket_id} everywhere (Cart.jsx and MyAccount.jsx) or add a real /play/:ticketId route that fetches ticket+contest before rendering.

Ensure checkout response includes first_contest_id or use first_contest_slug to build the registered play URL; then verify the post-checkout page renders data-testid=play-game-page and data-testid=play-later-btn.
Fix /api/orders/my-tickets enrichment to return contest.image from the actual image field and only show Play now when contest.game_type exists and entry_mode is skill_game.
Repair/refresh required contest c_8f482282e502 test data if it is meant to be a live skill_game: it is currently sold out and has game_type=null.
Make required contest leaderboards reachable from /leaderboard when game_scores exist, or document/tab them independently of game_type if that is the expected user behavior.
After checkout routing is fixed, retest the 24-hour homepage/notification-section reminder for at least one unplayed attempt.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js defines only <Route path="/play/:contestId/:ticketId" element={<PlayGame />} />, but Cart.jsx redirects to nav(`/play/${r.first_ticket_id}?just_bought=1`) and MyAccount.jsx links to `/play/${t.ticket_id}`. This is the root cause of the blank page.
PlayGame.jsx destructures { contestId, ticketId } and fetches contest by contestId from the public list. It cannot render correctly when only ticket_id is in the URL.
order_routes.my_tickets projects hero_image as contest.image, but current contest docs expose image. Existing ticket response has contest.image=null.
MyAccount.jsx determines canPlay from entry_mode/status only and does not require c.game_type, so it can show Play now for tickets whose contest has no playable game.

rca_of_the_issue: The white blank page is caused by route mismatch, not payment failure. Checkout succeeds and shows a payment success toast, then Cart navigates to /play/{ticket_id}. React Router has no /play/:ticketId route, only /play/:contestId/:ticketId, so no PlayGame content mounts. My Tickets has the same bad /play/{ticket_id} link. Separately, ticket enrichment uses the wrong contest image field and can mark non-game tickets playable.
